rv.q: It should be compulsory viewing for everyone – especially young people.
This is a unique piece of theatre describing one person's trans experience with honesty, authenticity and power.
Being so accessible makes this production as important to raising awareness of Trans issues as it is an enjoyable and entertaining piece of theatre.

cn.t: Pete MacHale's autobiographical one-person show about early transition earns strong praise for its honest, authentic, and multi-layered portrayal, blending humor and poignancy in an extraordinary performance that critics call unique and powerful.
